target_customer: Carriers, brokers, shippers and warehouses that schedule freight appointments
problem: Freight appointments are booked through portals, email and spreadsheets, so parties lack one shared record and incur detention and delays.
business_model: B2B SaaS, network across carriers, shippers and warehouses

founders.name: Deema Adada
founders.background_notes: 15 years in leadership roles per YC page

founders.name: Guillaume Lo Re
founders.background_notes: 13 years at startups and high-growth companies per YC page

competitors.name: Opendock
competitors.what: Dock scheduling platform for warehouses, brokers and carriers
competitors.traction_then: More than 1,800 warehouses used it per a June 2020 partnership post
competitors.funding_then: Aggregator lists a small $1M debt round; CB Insights lists acquisition by Loadsmart in 2021-11 (unverified)

technical_complexity.rationale: Many portal integrations and a shared shipment record across parties; standard SaaS engineering with integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Network of verified facilities and integrations can create switching costs, but this takes time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Opendock became part of Loadsmart per aggregator data; no source describes a direct incumbent move against BiggerPicture.

market_need_then: Manual appointment booking across portals and email; the YC page cites the founders' freight operations experience.

branding.domain_note: biggerpicture.co, a .co domain; no history found.

brand_strength.rationale: No sourced press or community about the brand; name is generic and common.

outcome_analysis: BiggerPicture appears to be an active freight scheduling company whose site claims 80,000 appointments monthly and 45,000 verified facilities, with SOC 2 Type I. Funding is unverified so the fundraising trajectory is unknown. Founder operating experience at Coyote and Uber Freight fits the domain; no shutdown or acquisition was found.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked lists a $500K pre-seed announced 2022-08 with Y Combinator and Carya Venture Partners, Dealroom gives a value estimate; no press release found so not recorded as a round. Traction figures are company claims from the current site, not as of founding. Education not found.
